title: Pipeline
description: A builder/challenger pipeline in .claude/expert-teams/pipelines/<name>.yaml. Each phase has exactly one builder, its reviewers check the results, and its consultants answer questions that come up.

schemaVersion.description: 2 since expert-teams 0.15.0: one builder, reviewers and consultants per phase. Version 1 had one participants list with modes; /expert-teams:migrate converts it.

name.description: Must match the file name without .json.

domains.description: Domain packs from <plugin>/domains/index.yaml whose knowledge create, modify and run load, e.g. [software] or [software, marketing]. Missing means [software], the only field of earlier versions.

inputs.description: Files or folders every phase may read.

models.description: A missing entry means opus. sonnet and haiku apply only where they are set explicitly.

humanInTheLoop.description: Who answers consult questions and settles stalemates. autonomous: the agents and the orchestrator settle everything and record their assumptions. as-needed (default): the agents settle everything except the cases in rules.askHumanWhen, which go to the user. always: every consult question and every stalemate goes to the user.

delivery.description: pr-merge: one pull request per phase into the integration branch, merged right away. pr-open: one pull request per phase, a human merges. commit: merge the phase locally, no pull request. The target is integrationBranch, or baseBranch if it is none.

integrationBranch.description: Branch all phases are merged into, created from baseBranch at the first run. Default expert-teams/<name>. When all phases are done, one pull request brings it into baseBranch; a human merges it. none: phases are merged straight into baseBranch.

preCommit.description: Command that must succeed before every commit in phases with code: true, e.g. npm run check, a spell or link check. null if there is none. The domain packs propose one.

pushEveryRound.description: Default true: after the build step and after the review step of every round the orchestrator commits the intermediate state with a checkpoint and pushes it to the phase branch, so a crashed run continues from there. Needs a remote. Checkpoint commits skip preCommit; the delivery commit still runs it.

worktrees.description: true: each phase runs in its own git worktree and phases run in parallel. false: phases run one after another in the main directory.

readOnly.description: Paths no agent may change, e.g. the user's inputs.

language.description: Languages of what the agents write, as ISO 639-1 codes. Each defaults to en.

code.description: Code and everything around it: identifiers, database tables and columns, API paths and fields, code comments, log messages, test names, commit messages and branch names.

docs.description: Documents: specifications, plans, briefs, decision logs, READMEs.

ui.description: Texts the audience sees: the user interface of a product, or published copy such as posts, emails and ads.

notes.description: Further project rules in plain text, included in every agent task.

askHumanWhen.description: Only for humanInTheLoop as-needed: the cases that go to the user, in plain text, e.g. contradiction with the inputs, change of scope, prices and money amounts.

consult.description: Consult relation: a role pauses on a side question, the orchestrator gets the answer and resumes the role with its full context.

maxPerRound.description: How often one role may pause for questions in one round. Default 3.

builder.description: The one role that creates the results of the phase.

agent.description: Name of an agent file in .claude/agents/.

reviewer.description: A role that checks the builder's results. It does not change files.

agent.description: Name of an agent file in .claude/agents/.

consultant.description: A role the orchestrator asks first when the builder or a reviewer of the phase has a consult question. It neither builds nor reviews.

agent.description: Name of an agent file in .claude/agents/.

about.description: What to ask this role, e.g. tax and invoicing rules. Helps the orchestrator pick the right consultant.

from.description: YAML file with the work packages, produced by an earlier phase. Each package has id, type, dependsOn and the files it may change. Types are free names (e.g. backend, post); builderByType and reviewersByType need an entry for each type used.

code.description: true marks a phase whose results rules.preCommit checks (code, or e.g. a site build): the check runs before every commit.

builder.description: Exactly one builder. Required unless the phase has workPackages, which name one builder per package type.

reviewers.description: Required unless the phase has workPackages.

consultants.description: Optional. Without it the orchestrator picks a fitting role of the pipeline for a consult question. Work packages use the consultants of their phase.
